# Reinforcement learning

For new RL, RLVR or GRPO work with supported Olmo MoE models, use
`python -m open_instruct.miles` and follow [the MILES guide](docs/miles/grpo.md),
including its launch checks and configuration conventions. Existing Core/vLLM
(`grpo.py`) and DeepSpeed/vLLM (`grpo_fast.py`) workflows remain current alternatives
for dense-model training; see [their guide](docs/algorithms/grpo.md).
Choose according to model and workload support, preserve the user's selected
workflow, and identify support gaps explicitly. MILES does not deprecate the
existing GRPO trainers.

For MILES GPU runs on `ai2/jupiter` or `ai2/saturn` (CUDA 12.8 host drivers), keep
the pinned MILES image: RunSpec defaults `launch.env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to the image's
CUDA compatibility libraries, and an explicit value wins. Revalidate CUDA
initialization and a short training run when the image or driver changes. See
[Jupiter CUDA compatibility](docs/miles/launching.md#jupiter-cuda-compatibility).

# Bash commands
- `uv run pytest`: Run the tests.
- `make style && make quality` run the linter + formatter.
- `uv run mkdocs serve`: View the documentation locally at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
- `uv run mkdocs build`: Build the documentation to the `site/` directory.



## Code Review Rules

Read and follow [CODE_REVIEW.md](CODE_REVIEW.md) when reviewing code.

# Workflow
- Begin every GitHub comment published by an agent with one plain line naming the agent (e.g. Codex, Claude Code): `Drafted by {agent name}.`, with no alert or other formatting. If a person reviewed the response before publication, use `Drafted by {agent name} and reviewed by {reviewer's name}.` instead. Only include the review attribution when that person actually reviewed the response; permission to post alone does not count as review.
- When a PR changes anything under `open_instruct/`, add a summary to `CHANGELOG.md` with a link to the PR (e.g., `- Description of change (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/123).`). This is what CI enforces; PRs touching only `scripts/`, docs, or config are exempt, though an entry is still welcome for anything user-visible.
  - The entry must contain the PR's own URL, which does not exist until the PR is opened. Add the entry, open the PR, then amend the entry with the URL and push again.
  - To skip the check deliberately, put `CHANGELOG=<reason>` in the PR body.
- Always run the linter and make sure the tests pass before finishing a task.
- Prefer running single tests, not the whole suite, when developing.
- Launch Beaker experiment and test scripts with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh [--cuda-version 12|13] SCRIPT` after committing all changes. CUDA 13 images are for compatible clusters such as `ai2/holmes`. MILES uses `--miles CONFIG` and its pinned runtime.
- For the Core/vLLM and DeepSpeed/vLLM GRPO workflows, we have three test scripts (for MILES checks, follow `docs/miles/architecture.md`):
  - `scripts/train/debug/single_gpu_on_beaker.sh`: single GPU, no tools (~8 minutes).
  - `scripts/train/debug/tools/olmo_3_parser_multigpu.sh`: multi GPU, with tools.
  - `scripts/train/debug/large_test_script.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes, no tools (~32 minutes).
- For OLMo-core SFT, we have two test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_multinode.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- For DPO, we have three test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/local.sh`: local single GPU (no Beaker).
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/single_gpu.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/multi_node.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- Launch the GPU tests with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`.
- CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners without Beaker experiments or image publication. Run GPU tests manually when a change touches GPU code paths. Record `GPU_TESTS=[EXPERIMENT_ID](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)` in the PR body for reviewers; CI does not parse or verify this line, and `GPU_TESTS=bypass` has no effect. The experiment must actually run `scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`; record training/debug smoke runs separately. Existing `open_instruct_auto*` images are no longer refreshed by CI; build from the intended revision with the launcher.
- If you are given a Beaker URL (`beaker.org` or `beaker.allen.ai`), use the Beaker CLI tool to interact with it.
- When a Beaker job stays queued or pending, run `beaker job events <job-id>` before diagnosing why — it prints the scheduler's own reason; don't infer one from cluster documentation. If that reason is the workspace slot limit, it applies to every cluster at once: wait or request fewer GPUs rather than relaunching elsewhere.
- A Beaker experiment can hold several jobs when a preempted one is retried. Read the most recently created attempt for each task and replica rank, not `jobs[0]` or one latest job for the entire experiment, or a successful retry looks like a failure and missing replicas can be overlooked.
- Mason's `--min_runtime <duration>` sets Beaker's `minRuntime` (0, or a duration with a unit of at least 5m, such as `30m`; Ai2 clusters currently allow at most 8h), and `--auto_resume` sets `autoResume`. On allocation-scheduled clusters, a job with a min runtime above 0 is allocated: it queues ahead of backfill and is protected until its min runtime ends, and shorter min runtimes schedule sooner. Its workspace needs an allocation on that cluster, or Beaker rejects it at submission. The legacy `--preemptible` switch, which cannot be combined with `--min_runtime`, maps to `minRuntime: 0` and `autoResume: true`; such unallocated jobs run only as backfill and may wait indefinitely. Passing neither flag maps to an eight-hour protected, non-resumable job, the hardest kind to schedule. Prefer a realistic `--min_runtime` (the time the job needs to reach a checkpoint), and call out this choice before launching instead of silently copying a checked-in script's choice.
- On macOS, GRPO launch scripts that call `mason.py` need `--no_auto_dataset_cache` (before the `--` separator). Local dataset caching runs the training entrypoint with `--cache_dataset_only`, and `grpo.py` / `grpo_fast.py` still import vllm at module level (`grpo_fast.py` from `vllm.distributed.weight_transfer`, `grpo.py` via `vllm_utils`), which is not installed on Darwin. `finetune.py`, `dpo.py`, `dpo_tune_cache.py` and `reward_modeling.py` no longer import vllm on this path since [#1866](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/1866), so their scripts do not need the flag. `mason.py` prints a macOS hint but still attempts caching, so it does not protect you either way.
- The `oe-eval-internal` directory is required in the Docker image for experiments that use `--try_launch_beaker_eval_jobs_on_weka`. If it's missing (e.g. in a fresh clone or worktree), clone it with: `git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/allenai/oe-eval-internal.git oe-eval-internal`.
- When updating PR bodies with experiment results, use the "Runs:" format (numbered list with Beaker links):
  ```
  Runs:

  1. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  2. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  ```

# Naming conventions
- Models OLMo and OLMo 2 (versions <=2) use the "OLMo" capitalization style.
- Olmo 3, Olmo Hybrid, and later models use "Olmo" (standard proper noun capitalization).
- Note: "OLMo-core" refers to the software repository and keeps its original capitalization.

# Coding conventions
- Never use `import logging` or `logging.info()` directly. Always use `logger = logger_utils.setup_logger(__name__)` and `logger.info()`.
- Imports always go at the top of the file, never inline.
- Use `from package import module` instead of `import package.module`.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

232	### 4.3 Math/GSM8K 验证器与数学等价判定
233	
234	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
235	
236	数学判分要解决两个正交问题：
237	
238	1. **答案抽取**：模型输出是一大段推理文字，标准答案藏在哪里？`MathVerifier` 依次尝试 `\boxed{}`、Minerva 格式（`Final Answer: The final answer is $...$. I hope it is correct.`）、最后一个 `$...$` 对，最后回退到整段输出。`GSM8KVerifier` 则简单得多——取文本里**最后一个数字**。
239	2. **等价判定**：抽出来的字符串和真值怎么算「相等」？`0.5` 和 `\frac{1}{2}`、`96.00` 和 `96` 字符串上不等但数学上相等。两级判定：`is_equiv` 用 sympy 做符号等价（强但慢、可能超时），`hendrycks_is_equiv` 用一套字符串规范化做弱等价（快但只覆盖书写差异）。
240	
241	GSM8K 另有一条独立的精确数值路径：用 `Decimal` 解析后精确比较，避免浮点误差和 `96.0 != 96` 这类假阴性；非数字标签回退到忽略大小写的字符串相等。
242	
243	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
244	
245	`MathVerifier.__call__`（[L245-L300](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L245-L300)）：
246	
247	```text
248	candidates = []
249	1. boxed:  last_boxed_only_string(raw) → remove_boxed → 加入
250	2. Minerva: get_unnormalized_answer → normalize_final_answer → 加入（若非 [invalidanswer]）
251	3. 仅当前两步全空: 取最后一对 $...$ 之间的内容规范化后加入
252	4. 仍为空: normalize_final_answer(整段) 和 原始整段 都加入
253	for ans in candidates:
254	    if is_equiv(ans, label) or hendrycks_is_equiv(ans, label): return 1.0
255	return 0.0
256	```
257	
258	`is_equiv` 的符号判定（[math_utils.py:L177-L212](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/math_utils.py#L177-L212)）：
259	
260	\[ \text{equiv}(x_1, x_2) \iff \operatorname{simplify}\big(\operatorname{parse\_latex}(x_1) - \operatorname{parse\_latex}(x_2)\big) = 0 \]
261	
262	整个比较包在 5 秒的 `SIGALRM` 超时里，超时计入 `diagnostics["symbolic_timeouts"]`（供 `MathVerifier` 透传到 `VerificationResult.diagnostics`）并返回 False——符号引擎卡死不会拖垮训练循环。
263	
264	`hendrycks_is_equiv` 则是 `strip_string(both) == ` 后的字符串比较，`strip_string`（[L287-L347](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/math_utils.py#L287-L347)）做约 15 类规范化：删 `\left`/`\right`、`tfrac→frac`、百分号、单位、多余空格，补全 `\sqrt2 → \sqrt{2}`、`\frac12 → \frac{1}{2}`，甚至把 `0.5` 定死成 `\frac{1}{2}`。
265	
266	`GSM8KVerifier.__call__`（[L216-L242](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L216-L242)）：
267	
268	```text
269	去千分位逗号 → 正则 [-+]?(?:\d*\.\d+|\d+) 找全部数字 → 取最后一个
270	found, expected = Decimal(extracted), Decimal(label)      # _exact_number
271	若两者都可解析: 精确比较 Decimal 相等
272	否则: 忽略大小写的字符串比较
273	```

276

330	### 4.4 selected_input 与 grading_* 声明：MILES 统一判分的消费者契约（本轮更新）
331	
332	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
333	
334	这是本轮增量（PR #2250「Unify MILES grading inputs」）落在 `ground_truth_utils` 上的部分，完整机制在 u8-l12 讲解，这里只讲**本文件消费者视角**的迁移契约。
335	
336	问题背景：思考模型的输出是 `<think>…</think>正文`。历史上每个验证器各自调用 `remove_thinking_section` 或 `extract_final_answer`，用 `split("</think>")[-1]` 这类规则「自己找答案边界」。边界情况（prompt 预填了闭合的 `</think>`、输出中途重开 `<think>`、非思考模式夹带标签）在每个消费者里各处理一遍，容易不一致。
337	
338	MILES 的解法是**共享选择器切一次**：`open_instruct/miles/rewards/grading.py` 的 `split_response` 一次性把原始输出切成 `ResponseParts`（thinking / delivered response），判分层再把「选定的输入」传给验证器。于是验证器侧需要两件事：
339	
340	1. **行为开关 `selected_input=True`**：传入的 `prediction` 已经是切好的选定文本，消费者**不得再切思考边界**。谁有能力接收这个开关？在类上声明 `grading_accepts_selected_input = True` 的验证器。注意任务级解析（`<answer>` 标签、`<|assistant|>` 清理、代码块、JSON）**保留不变**——那些是「任务格式」，不是「思考边界」。
341	2. **声明式输入契约 `grading_*` 类属性**：告诉判分层「我需要什么输入」。本轮 `MaxLenVerifier`/`UpToMaxLenVerifier` 声明了 `grading_objective = "process"`、`grading_scope = "full"`、`grading_uses_tokens = True`——它们按 token 计分，需要**整条轨迹**（含思考）的 token 序列，而不是切出的最终答案文本。
342	
343	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
344	
345	调用侧（MILES，[rewards.py:L539-L560](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/rewards/rewards.py#L539-L560)）：
346	
347	```text
348	policy = 判分策略（由数据声明/registry 解析）
349	if policy 存在 且 verifier.grading_accepts_selected_input:
350	    extra["selected_input"] = True        # 传入"已选定"标记
351	tokens = 整条轨迹 tokens，仅当 policy.scope == "full" 时下发
352	    （token 计分器要求 full scope，否则只能拿到空列表）
353	```
354	
355	验证器侧（本文件）：
356	
357	```text
358	async_call(..., selected_input=True)          # 基类把它透传进 __call__
359	  → remove_thinking_section(prediction, selected_input=True)
360	       跳过 split("</think>")，但保留 <answer> 标签剥离与 <｜assistant｜> 清理
361	  → extract_final_answer(prediction, selected_input=True)
362	       跳过 </think> 后缀匹配，保留 <answer>…</answer> 抽取
363	```
364	
365	兼容性设计：基类 `async_call` 只在 `selected_input=True` 时注入该关键字（4.1.3），因此**未声明**的旧验证器在传统路径（`apply_verifiable_reward`，从不传 `selected_input`）行为零变化；MILES 只对声明了 `grading_accepts_selected_input` 的验证器置位（rewards.py L544-L545），双向保护。

423	
424	**练习 3**：`grading_uses_tokens = True` 的验证器如果把 `grading_scope` 声明成 `"response"`，会出什么问题？
425	
426	**答案**：MILES 调用侧只在 `policy.scope == "full"` 时下发轨迹 token（[rewards.py:L520-L525](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/rewards/rewards.py#L520-L525)），scope 不是 full 时 token 被置空，长度打分全部失真；且「token 计分器要求 full scope」会在 registry 加载校验时被拒绝（u8-l12 的 `validate_registry`）。
427	
428	## 5. 综合实践
429	
430	把本讲四个模块串起来：**写一个质数判断验证器，走完「定义 → 注册 → 分发 → 判分 → 契约声明」全链路。**
431	
432	### 实践目标
433	
434	实现 `PrimeVerifier`：从模型输出抽取最后一个整数，判断它是否为质数；`label` 取 `"prime"` 或 `"not_prime"`。同时让它符合本轮新增的消费者契约（接受 `selected_input`）。
435	
436	### 操作步骤（示例代码）
437	
438	在仓库根目录新建临时脚本运行（不要改动 `open_instruct/` 源码）：
439	
440	```python
441	import asyncio
442	import re
443	from types import SimpleNamespace
444	
445	from open_instruct.ground_truth_utils import (
446	    RewardConfig, VerifierConfig, VerifierFunction, VerificationResult, apply_verifiable_reward,
447	)
448	
449	
450	class PrimeVerifier(VerifierFunction):
451	    """答案应为（或不应为）质数：label ∈ {"prime", "not_prime"}。"""
452	
453	    grading_accepts_selected_input = True   # 声明：可接收已切分好的选定输入
454	
455	    def __call__(self, tokenized_prediction, prediction, label,
456	                 query=None, rollout_state=None, *, selected_input=False):
457	        # 任务级解析：取最后一个整数（模仿 GSM8KVerifier 的抽取方式）
458	        numbers = re.findall(r"-?\d+", prediction)
459	        if not numbers:
460	            return VerificationResult(score=0.0)
461	        n = int(numbers[-1])
462	        is_prime = n > 1 and all(n % d for d in range(2, int(n**0.5) + 1))
463	        want_prime = str(label).strip().lower() == "prime"
464	        return VerificationResult(score=float(is_prime == want_prime))
465	
466	
467	# 1. 五组样例验证打分
468	cases = [
469	    ("The answer is 7",  "prime",     1.0),
470	    ("The answer is 8",  "prime",     0.0),
471	    (r"\boxed{2}",       "prime",     1.0),
472	    ("<answer>9</answer>", "not_prime", 1.0),
473	    ("答案是 42",         "not_prime", 1.0),
474	]
475	v = PrimeVerifier(VerifierConfig(), )  # name 默认取构造参数；也可 super().__init__("prime_check")
476	for pred, label, want in cases:
477	    got = v([], pred, label).score
478	    assert got == want, (pred, label, got, want)
479	
480	# 2. 接入 RewardConfig 并走分发链路（dataset 名 = 注册 key）
481	mapping = {"prime_check": v}
482	rewards, per_func = asyncio.run(apply_verifiable_reward(
483	    reward_fn_mapping=mapping,
484	    responses=[[9], [9], [9], [9], [9]],
485	    decoded_responses=[c[0] for c in cases],
486	    ground_truths=[c[1] for c in cases],
487	    datasets=["prime_check"] * 5,
488	))
489	print(rewards, per_func)
490	
491	# 3. 验证 selected_input 通路：异步调用并置位（基类会把它透传给 __call__）
492	result = asyncio.run(v.async_call(
493	    [], "<think>7 是质数</think>答案就是 7", "prime", selected_input=True))
494	print(result)   # __call__ 收到 selected_input=True，本验证器不切边界也能抽到最后数字 7 → 1.0
495	```
496	
497	### 需要观察的现象
498	
499	- 五组样例断言全部通过（含负号正则不误伤 `not_prime` 场景）。
500	- `apply_verifiable_reward` 返回的 `rewards` 全为 1.0（默认 `reward_mult=1.0`），`per_func` 只含 `prime_check` 一个 key。
501	- 第 3 步 `async_call(..., selected_input=True)` 正常返回 score=1.0——证明声明与签名成对后，基类透传链路可用。
502	
503	### 预期结果与扩展
504	
505	- 想让它进入 `build_all_verifiers` 自动注册，只需把类放进某个被 import 的模块并让构造函数调用 `super().__init__("prime_check", weight=1.0)`；然后在数据制备（u3-l3）把样本的 `dataset` 字段写成 `prime_check`。
506	- 对照检查：`UpToMaxLenVerifier.grading_objective/grading_scope/grading_uses_tokens`（[L709-L711](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L709-L711)）与你的 `grading_accepts_selected_input`——一个是「我要什么输入」的契约，一个是「我能吃选定输入」的能力开关。
507	- 以上运行结果**待本地验证**；如断言失败，优先检查正则 `-?\d+` 是否把 `not_prime` 里的数字抓走（它出现在 label 而非 prediction，不影响）。
508	
509	## 6. 本讲小结
510	
511	- 验证器的统一契约是 `VerifierFunction`：`__call__(tok, prediction, label, query, rollout_state) → VerificationResult(score, cost, reasoning, diagnostics)`，配置经 `VerifierConfig.from_args` 字段名反射注入。
512	- 注册表是**运行时自动发现**的：`build_all_verifiers` 枚举 `__subclasses__()`，以实例 `name` 为 key；样本按 `dataset` 字段查表，由 `apply_verifiable_reward` 并发分发并按 `weight × reward_mult` 加权汇总。
513	- 数学判分 = 多策略抽取（boxed → Minerva → 最后 `$...$` → 整段回退）+ 两级等价判定（sympy 符号差为零 / `strip_string` 字符串规范化），GSM8K 用 `Decimal` 精确数值比较。
514	- 本轮更新（PR #2250）给这套体系接上了 MILES 统一判分入口：`async_call` 新增 `selected_input` 关键字（基类仅在其为 True 时透传），`IFEval/F1/Puzzle/LMJudge` 等消费者声明 `grading_accepts_selected_input` 并在 `selected_input=True` 时**不再二次切分思考边界**（`remove_thinking_section`/`extract_final_answer` 保留任务级 `<answer>` 解析）。
515	- `MaxLen/UpToMaxLen` 用 `grading_objective/grading_scope/grading_uses_tokens` 声明「过程目标、全轨迹、需要 token」的输入契约，MILES 读取这些声明决定下发整条轨迹 token 还是选定文本。
516	- 传统 grpo.py / grpo_fast.py 路径完全不传 `selected_input`，行为与更新前一致——新契约是纯增量。
517	
518	## 7. 下一步学习建议
519	
520	- **u6-l2（GRPO 损失与优势计算）**：验证器产生的标量奖励如何变成组相对优势并进入策略梯度——奖励消费的下一站。
521	- **u6-l6（工具调用 RL 环境）**：`rollout_state` 里的逐轮奖励如何被 `LastRewardAggregator`/`SumRewardAggregator` 聚合，`RewardConfig.build` 的完整门控逻辑（格式奖励、non-stop 惩罚）在那里展开。
522	- **u8-l12（MILES 统一判分输入）**：`split_response`/`ResponseParts` 共享选择器、`GradingPolicy` 的 objective×scope×require_response 组合约束，以及 `_VerifierRegistry` 如何校验本文这些 `grading_*` 声明——本讲 4.4 的完整上游故事。
523	- **u6-l7 / u6-l8（代码奖励与执行客户端）**：`CodeVerifier` 的外部执行服务、`code_stdio` 克隆与沙箱协议，验证器家族中最重的一支。

# u6-l3 可验证奖励：verifier 注册表与数学判分

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说清楚 `VerifierFunction` 抽象基类的契约：输入什么、输出什么、配置怎么注入、同步与异步两条调用路径如何衔接。
2. 理解验证器的「自动发现」机制：为什么只要写一个子类，`build_all_verifiers` 就能枚举它，以及样本如何按数据集名被分发到对应验证器（`apply_verifiable_reward`）。
3. 掌握数学判分的两级流程：boxed/Minerva 答案抽取 + sympy 符号等价与 hendrycks 字符串规范化等价的组合判定。
4. 能独立编写并接入一个自定义验证器（本讲实践：质数判断验证器）。
5. 理解本轮更新引入的 `selected_input` 关键字参数与 `grading_*` 类属性声明：它们是 MILES 统一判分入口（详见 u8-l12）在 `ground_truth_utils` 这一层落地的「消费者迁移契约」——共享选择器只切一次思考边界，任务解析器不再各自二次切分。

## 2. 前置知识

- **RLVR（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards）**：对有标准答案的任务（数学、代码、指令遵循），我们不训练奖励模型，而是用一个「验证器」程序直接判定模型输出对不对，输出分数当作奖励信号。这是 GRPO 训练（u6-l1）中奖励的来源之一。
- **ground truth（真值）**：每条训练样本自带的标签字段，可能是标准答案（`"42"`）、约束（IFEval 的指令 id 列表）、测试用例（代码题）或 rubric。验证器拿「模型输出 + 真值」打分。
- **验证器（verifier）**：一个「谓词式」的判分函数：`(prediction, label) → score ∈ [0, 1]`。它不产生梯度，只产生标量奖励。
- **思考模型与 `</think>` 边界**：推理模型的输出通常形如 `<think>推理过程…</think>最终答案`。历史代码里每个验证器各自用 `split("</think>")[-1]` 切掉思考段——本轮更新把这件事统一交给 MILES 判分层的共享选择器（`split_response`），验证器通过 `selected_input=True` 声明「传给我的已经是切好的」。
- **sympy**：Python 的符号数学库。`parse_latex` 能把 LaTeX 字符串解析成符号表达式，`simplify(expr1 - expr2) == 0` 即可判断两个写法不同的答案在数学上是否等价（如 `0.5` 与 `\frac{1}{2}`）。
- **异步与线程池**：RL 训练中判分往往和 GPU 推理并发，验证器因此提供 `async_call`；基类默认实现是把同步 `__call__` 丢进线程池，避免阻塞事件循环。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py) | 验证器家族与注册表：`VerifierFunction` 基类、`VerificationResult`、约 20 个内置验证器、`build_all_verifiers` 自动发现、`apply_verifiable_reward` 分发、`RewardConfig` 奖励组装 |
| [open_instruct/math_utils.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/math_utils.py) | 数学判分工具：`last_boxed_only_string` boxed 抽取、`normalize_final_answer`/`strip_string` 两套规范化、`is_equiv`（sympy 符号等价）与 `hendrycks_is_equiv`（字符串等价） |
| [open_instruct/answer_utils.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/answer_utils.py) | 只依赖标准库的共享答案抽取：`extract_final_answer`（本轮新增 `selected_input` 参数） |

| [open_instruct/test_math_utils.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_math_utils.py) | `strip_string` 规范化单测 |
| [open_instruct/grpo.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/grpo.py) | 消费方示例：`main` 里用 `build_all_verifiers` 组装 `RewardConfig`（[L183-L193](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/grpo.py#L183-L193)） |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 VerifierFunction 基类：验证器的统一契约

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

所有验证器共用一个抽象基类 `VerifierFunction`。它定义了三件事：

1. **统一签名**：`__call__(tokenized_prediction, prediction, label, query, rollout_state)`。`prediction` 是解码后的模型输出文本，`label` 是真值，`tokenized_prediction` 是 token id 列表（绝大多数验证器不用它，但按 token 长度打分的验证器需要），`query` 是原始问题（LM 裁判需要），`rollout_state` 携带多轮工具调用的逐轮奖励（u6-l6 会用到）。
2. **统一返回**：`VerificationResult(score, cost, reasoning, diagnostics)`——分数之外还带成本（LLM 裁判的 API 花费）、判分理由和诊断信息（如 sympy 超时计数）。
3. **统一异步路径**：`async_call` 默认把同步 `__call__` 丢进线程池；真正异步的验证器（LM 裁判、代码执行）自己重写它。

配置注入走 `VerifierConfig` 数据类家族：每个验证器类声明自己的 `get_config_class()`，`from_args` 用「字段名反射」从训练参数对象里自动抓取同名字段——这就是为什么给某个验证器加配置项只需要在 config 数据类里加字段。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
训练脚本 (grpo.py / grpo_fast.py)
    │
    ├─ args（argparse Namespace，含全部训练参数）
    │     │
    │     ▼
    ├─ build_all_verifiers(args)
    │     枚举 VerifierFunction.__subclasses__()
    │     每个子类: get_config_class().from_args(args) → 实例化 → 按 name 注册
    │     → dict[str, VerifierFunction] （key = 数据集名，如 "math" / "gsm8k"）
    │
    └─ RewardConfig(verifier_functions=上述 dict).build() → reward_fn
          训练循环每个 batch 调用 reward_fn
              └─ apply_verifiable_reward(...)   # 见 4.2
```

单个验证器内部的两条调用路径：

```text
同步: verifier(tok, prediction, label, query, rollout_state) → VerificationResult
异步: await verifier.async_call(tok, prediction, label, query, rollout_state,
                                 *, selected_input=False)
        基类默认实现: loop.run_in_executor(None, lambda: self.__call__(...))
        selected_input=True 时才把该关键字透传进 __call__
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

返回值结构 [open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py:L97-L102](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L97-L102)：`score` 必填，`cost`/`reasoning`/`diagnostics` 可选——这让「免费的确实验证器」和「按 token 计费的裁判」共享同一个返回类型。

基类定义 [open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py:L110-L188](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L110-L188)：

- [L118-L121](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L118-L121)：构造函数保存 `name`（即注册表 key，必须与数据集名对上）、`weight`（多条真值加权时的权重）和 `verifier_config`。
- [L133-L154](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L133-L154)：抽象 `__call__`，注意它的签名**没有** `selected_input`——这是有意为之，见 4.4。
- [L156-L185](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L156-L185)：本轮更新后的 `async_call`，新增关键字参数 `selected_input: bool = False`（[L163-L165](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L163-L165)）。关键实现技巧在 [L182-L184](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L182-L184)：只有当 `selected_input=True` 时才构造 `{"selected_input": True}` 并透传给 `__call__`。这样**没有**声明接受该参数的旧验证器子类在默认路径下完全不受影响，而声明了 `grading_accepts_selected_input = True` 的消费者（见 4.4）可以安全接收它。
- [L187-L188](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L187-L188)：`__repr__` 带类名与注册名，日志排查时能直接看出是哪个验证器打了分。

配置注入 [open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py:L54-L75](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L54-L75)：`VerifierConfig.from_args(*arg_sources)` 遍历数据类字段名，从每个参数源上 `getattr` 同名属性，后源覆盖前源。基础 `VerifierConfig` 没有任何字段，所以「无配置需求」的验证器传任何 args 都能构造。带字段的子类如 [L78-L86](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L78-L86) 的 `LMJudgeVerifierConfig`（注意这些字段**没有默认值**，意味着 `build_all_verifiers` 要求 args 上必须带齐裁判配置——实践里的一个坑，见 4.2.4）。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：用最直接的方式跑通一次验证器调用，确认环境可用。

**操作步骤**：

1. 进入仓库根目录（已 `uv sync`，见 u1-l2）。
2. 运行仓库自带的验证器单测：

   ```bash
   uv run pytest open_instruct/test_ground_truth_utils.py -k "GSM8K or Puzzle" -q
   ```

3. 再在 Python 里手工调用一次（**示例代码**）：

   ```python
   from open_instruct.ground_truth_utils import GSM8KVerifier

   v = GSM8KVerifier()
   print(v([], "Therefore the answer is -3", "-3"))        # score=1.0
   print(v([], "The total cost is $96.00", "96"))           # score=1.0（Decimal 精确比较）
   ```

### 4.2 验证器自动发现与 apply_verifiable_reward 分发

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

「注册表」在当前代码里不是一张手写的字典，而是**运行时自动构建**的：`build_all_verifiers` 用 `VerifierFunction.__subclasses__()` 枚举所有已导入的子类，以每个实例的 `name`（小写）为 key 组成映射。数据侧每个样本带一个 `dataset` 字段（数据集名），打分时用这个名字查表——**数据集名就是路由键**。这就是文件顶部注释「Add new verifiers by subclassing VerifierFunction … automatically added」的含义（注意 [L1-L6](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L1-L6) 的 docstring 还提到 `REWARD_FN_MAPPING`，这是历史名称，当前实现里该全局变量已不存在，以 `build_all_verifiers` 为准）。

`apply_verifiable_reward` 则是批量分发器：把一个 batch 的（response, ground_truth, dataset）三元组逐条查表、并发调用 `async_call`，再把每个验证器的分数按 `weight × reward_mult` 加权累加回每条 response。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

`build_all_verifiers` 的流程（[L1239-L1276](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L1239-L1276)）：

```text
for subclass in VerifierFunction.__subclasses__():
    if subclass == LMJudgeVerifier: continue          # 裁判单独处理
    config = subclass.get_config_class().from_args(args, streaming_config)
    verifiers[instance.name.lower()] = subclass(config)
    if subclass == CodeVerifier:                       # 额外克隆一个 stdio 版
        verifiers["code_stdio"] = ...
for judge_type in JUDGE_PROMPT_MAP:                    # 每种裁判类型一个实例
    verifiers[f"general-{judge_type}"] = LMJudgeVerifier(...)
if streaming_config.remap_verifier:                    # 可选改名路由
    verifiers[old_name] = verifiers[new_name]
```

`apply_verifiable_reward` 的流程（[L1298-L1361](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L1298-L1361)）：

```text
for 每条 response:
    ground_truth_list = [gt] if isinstance(gt, str) else gt   # 一条 response 可配多条真值
    for (gt, ds) in zip(ground_truth_list, dataset_list):
        reward_func = mapping.get(ds.lower())                  # 数据集名 → 验证器
        if None: log warning, skip
        task = reward_func.async_call(tok, prediction, gt, query, rollout_state)
asyncio.gather(*tasks)                                          # 并发判分
for 每个结果:
    weighted = reward_mult × score × reward_func.weight
    response_rewards[i] += weighted
    response_per_func_rewards[i][验证器名] += weighted           # 分函数指标
```

### 4.3 Math/GSM8K 验证器与数学等价判定

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

数学判分要解决两个正交问题：

1. **答案抽取**：模型输出是一大段推理文字，标准答案藏在哪里？`MathVerifier` 依次尝试 `\boxed{}`、Minerva 格式（`Final Answer: The final answer is $...$. I hope it is correct.`）、最后一个 `$...$` 对，最后回退到整段输出。`GSM8KVerifier` 则简单得多——取文本里**最后一个数字**。
2. **等价判定**：抽出来的字符串和真值怎么算「相等」？`0.5` 和 `\frac{1}{2}`、`96.00` 和 `96` 字符串上不等但数学上相等。两级判定：`is_equiv` 用 sympy 做符号等价（强但慢、可能超时），`hendrycks_is_equiv` 用一套字符串规范化做弱等价（快但只覆盖书写差异）。

GSM8K 另有一条独立的精确数值路径：用 `Decimal` 解析后精确比较，避免浮点误差和 `96.0 != 96` 这类假阴性；非数字标签回退到忽略大小写的字符串相等。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`MathVerifier.__call__`（[L245-L300](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L245-L300)）：

```text
candidates = []
1. boxed:  last_boxed_only_string(raw) → remove_boxed → 加入
2. Minerva: get_unnormalized_answer → normalize_final_answer → 加入（若非 [invalidanswer]）
3. 仅当前两步全空: 取最后一对 $...$ 之间的内容规范化后加入
4. 仍为空: normalize_final_answer(整段) 和 原始整段 都加入
for ans in candidates:
    if is_equiv(ans, label) or hendrycks_is_equiv(ans, label): return 1.0
return 0.0
```

`is_equiv` 的符号判定（[math_utils.py:L177-L212](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/math_utils.py#L177-L212)）：

\[ \text{equiv}(x_1, x_2) \iff \operatorname{simplify}\big(\operatorname{parse\_latex}(x_1) - \operatorname{parse\_latex}(x_2)\big) = 0 \]

整个比较包在 5 秒的 `SIGALRM` 超时里，超时计入 `diagnostics["symbolic_timeouts"]`（供 `MathVerifier` 透传到 `VerificationResult.diagnostics`）并返回 False——符号引擎卡死不会拖垮训练循环。

`hendrycks_is_equiv` 则是 `strip_string(both) == ` 后的字符串比较，`strip_string`（[L287-L347](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/math_utils.py#L287-L347)）做约 15 类规范化：删 `\left`/`\right`、`tfrac→frac`、百分号、单位、多余空格，补全 `\sqrt2 → \sqrt{2}`、`\frac12 → \frac{1}{2}`，甚至把 `0.5` 定死成 `\frac{1}{2}`。

`GSM8KVerifier.__call__`（[L216-L242](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L216-L242)）：

```text
去千分位逗号 → 正则 [-+]?(?:\d*\.\d+|\d+) 找全部数字 → 取最后一个
found, expected = Decimal(extracted), Decimal(label)      # _exact_number
若两者都可解析: 精确比较 Decimal 相等
否则: 忽略大小写的字符串比较
```

   ```python
   print(strict([], r"\boxed{7}", "7"))               # boxed 不属于 Minerva 格式 → 回退整段规范化
   ```

**需要观察的现象**：`strip_string("0.5")` 输出 `\frac{1}{2}`；`MathVerifier` 与 `StrictMathVerifier` 对 boxed 输出的判定差异。

**练习 2**：`MathVerifier` 为什么把「整段原始输出」也加进候选（[L290-L293](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L290-L293)）？

**答案**：这是最后的兜底。当模型既没写 boxed 也没写 Minerva 话术、也没有 `$...$` 时，如果整段输出本身就是答案（比如数据集的期望答案就是一段短文本），规范化后的整段与真值仍有机会匹配；同时保留未规范化原文，覆盖「规范化反而破坏匹配」的情况。

**练习 3**：`GSM8KVerifier` 为什么用 `Decimal` 而不是 `float` 比较？

**答案**：`float("96.00") == 96.0` 虽然为 True，但很多十进制小数（如 0.1）无法被二进制浮点精确表示，比较会产生假阴性/假阳性；`Decimal` 按十进制语义精确比较，且 `Decimal("96.00") == Decimal("96")` 为 True，正好覆盖「尾随零」用例（[test L180-L189](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_ground_truth_utils.py#L180-L189)）。

### 4.4 selected_input 与 grading_* 声明：MILES 统一判分的消费者契约（本轮更新）

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

这是本轮增量（PR #2250「Unify MILES grading inputs」）落在 `ground_truth_utils` 上的部分，完整机制在 u8-l12 讲解，这里只讲**本文件消费者视角**的迁移契约。

问题背景：思考模型的输出是 `<think>…</think>正文`。历史上每个验证器各自调用 `remove_thinking_section` 或 `extract_final_answer`，用 `split("</think>")[-1]` 这类规则「自己找答案边界」。边界情况（prompt 预填了闭合的 `</think>`、输出中途重开 `<think>`、非思考模式夹带标签）在每个消费者里各处理一遍，容易不一致。

MILES 的解法是**共享选择器切一次**：`open_instruct/miles/rewards/grading.py` 的 `split_response` 一次性把原始输出切成 `ResponseParts`（thinking / delivered response），判分层再把「选定的输入」传给验证器。于是验证器侧需要两件事：

1. **行为开关 `selected_input=True`**：传入的 `prediction` 已经是切好的选定文本，消费者**不得再切思考边界**。谁有能力接收这个开关？在类上声明 `grading_accepts_selected_input = True` 的验证器。注意任务级解析（`<answer>` 标签、`<|assistant|>` 清理、代码块、JSON）**保留不变**——那些是「任务格式」，不是「思考边界」。
2. **声明式输入契约 `grading_*` 类属性**：告诉判分层「我需要什么输入」。本轮 `MaxLenVerifier`/`UpToMaxLenVerifier` 声明了 `grading_objective = "process"`、`grading_scope = "full"`、`grading_uses_tokens = True`——它们按 token 计分，需要**整条轨迹**（含思考）的 token 序列，而不是切出的最终答案文本。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

调用侧（MILES，[rewards.py:L539-L560](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/rewards/rewards.py#L539-L560)）：

```text
policy = 判分策略（由数据声明/registry 解析）
if policy 存在 且 verifier.grading_accepts_selected_input:
    extra["selected_input"] = True        # 传入"已选定"标记
tokens = 整条轨迹 tokens，仅当 policy.scope == "full" 时下发
    （token 计分器要求 full scope，否则只能拿到空列表）
```

验证器侧（本文件）：

```text
async_call(..., selected_input=True)          # 基类把它透传进 __call__
  → remove_thinking_section(prediction, selected_input=True)
       跳过 split("</think>")，但保留 <answer> 标签剥离与 <｜assistant｜> 清理
  → extract_final_answer(prediction, selected_input=True)
       跳过 </think> 后缀匹配，保留 <answer>…</answer> 抽取
```

兼容性设计：基类 `async_call` 只在 `selected_input=True` 时注入该关键字（4.1.3），因此**未声明**的旧验证器在传统路径（`apply_verifiable_reward`，从不传 `selected_input`）行为零变化；MILES 只对声明了 `grading_accepts_selected_input` 的验证器置位（rewards.py L544-L545），双向保护。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`MathVerifier` 为什么**不**声明 `grading_accepts_selected_input`？

**答案**：`MathVerifier` 的候选抽取（`last_boxed_only_string`、最后一个 `$...$` 对、整段回退）本来就要扫**整段原始输出**（思考里出现 boxed 也算数，见 [L264](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L264) 直接用 `prediction`），它不需要「切好的选定输入」。MILES 侧对这类验证器继续传原始输出（其策略由 `grading_objective` 等声明或缺省值推导，见 u8-l12）。

**练习 2**：如果一个验证器声明了 `grading_accepts_selected_input = True` 但 `__call__` 签名里没写 `selected_input` 参数，会发生什么？

**答案**：MILES 置位 `extra["selected_input"] = True` 后，基类 `async_call` 会把它作为关键字参数注入 `self.__call__(..., selected_input=True)`（[L182-L184](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/ground_truth_utils.py#L182-L184)），签名不匹配直接抛 `TypeError`。声明与签名必须成对出现——这正是本轮迁移逐个修改 `IFEvalVerifier` 等子类签名的原因。

**练习 3**：`grading_uses_tokens = True` 的验证器如果把 `grading_scope` 声明成 `"response"`，会出什么问题？

**答案**：MILES 调用侧只在 `policy.scope == "full"` 时下发轨迹 token（[rewards.py:L520-L525](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/rewards/rewards.py#L520-L525)），scope 不是 full 时 token 被置空，长度打分全部失真；且「token 计分器要求 full scope」会在 registry 加载校验时被拒绝（u8-l12 的 `validate_registry`）。

## 5. 综合实践

把本讲四个模块串起来：**写一个质数判断验证器，走完「定义 → 注册 → 分发 → 判分 → 契约声明」全链路。**

### 实践目标

实现 `PrimeVerifier`：从模型输出抽取最后一个整数，判断它是否为质数；`label` 取 `"prime"` 或 `"not_prime"`。同时让它符合本轮新增的消费者契约（接受 `selected_input`）。

### 操作步骤（示例代码）

在仓库根目录新建临时脚本运行（不要改动 `open_instruct/` 源码）：

```python
import asyncio
import re
from types import SimpleNamespace

from open_instruct.ground_truth_utils import (
    RewardConfig, VerifierConfig, VerifierFunction, VerificationResult, apply_verifiable_reward,
)


class PrimeVerifier(VerifierFunction):
    """答案应为（或不应为）质数：label ∈ {"prime", "not_prime"}。"""

    grading_accepts_selected_input = True   # 声明：可接收已切分好的选定输入

    def __call__(self, tokenized_prediction, prediction, label,
                 query=None, rollout_state=None, *, selected_input=False):
        # 任务级解析：取最后一个整数（模仿 GSM8KVerifier 的抽取方式）
        numbers = re.findall(r"-?\d+", prediction)
        if not numbers:
            return VerificationResult(score=0.0)
        n = int(numbers[-1])
        is_prime = n > 1 and all(n % d for d in range(2, int(n**0.5) + 1))
        want_prime = str(label).strip().lower() == "prime"
        return VerificationResult(score=float(is_prime == want_prime))


# 1. 五组样例验证打分
cases = [
    ("The answer is 7",  "prime",     1.0),
    ("The answer is 8",  "prime",     0.0),
    (r"\boxed{2}",       "prime",     1.0),
    ("<answer>9</answer>", "not_prime", 1.0),
    ("答案是 42",         "not_prime", 1.0),
]
v = PrimeVerifier(VerifierConfig(), )  # name 默认取构造参数；也可 super().__init__("prime_check")
for pred, label, want in cases:
    got = v([], pred, label).score
    assert got == want, (pred, label, got, want)

# 2. 接入 RewardConfig 并走分发链路（dataset 名 = 注册 key）
mapping = {"prime_check": v}
rewards, per_func = asyncio.run(apply_verifiable_reward(
    reward_fn_mapping=mapping,
    responses=[[9], [9], [9], [9], [9]],
    decoded_responses=[c[0] for c in cases],
    ground_truths=[c[1] for c in cases],
    datasets=["prime_check"] * 5,
))
print(rewards, per_func)

# 3. 验证 selected_input 通路：异步调用并置位（基类会把它透传给 __call__）
result = asyncio.run(v.async_call(
    [], "<think>7 是质数</think>答案就是 7", "prime", selected_input=True))
print(result)   # __call__ 收到 selected_input=True，本验证器不切边界也能抽到最后数字 7 → 1.0
```

### 需要观察的现象

- 五组样例断言全部通过（含负号正则不误伤 `not_prime` 场景）。
- `apply_verifiable_reward` 返回的 `rewards` 全为 1.0（默认 `reward_mult=1.0`），`per_func` 只含 `prime_check` 一个 key。
- 第 3 步 `async_call(..., selected_input=True)` 正常返回 score=1.0——证明声明与签名成对后，基类透传链路可用。

## 6. 本讲小结

- 验证器的统一契约是 `VerifierFunction`：`__call__(tok, prediction, label, query, rollout_state) → VerificationResult(score, cost, reasoning, diagnostics)`，配置经 `VerifierConfig.from_args` 字段名反射注入。
- 注册表是**运行时自动发现**的：`build_all_verifiers` 枚举 `__subclasses__()`，以实例 `name` 为 key；样本按 `dataset` 字段查表，由 `apply_verifiable_reward` 并发分发并按 `weight × reward_mult` 加权汇总。

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).

Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
